name: pizza
description: A topping baked on bread dough: very stretchy and stringy when pulled, mild, milky and a little tangy, browns in spots, melts evenly.

name: mac_and_cheese
description: A smooth, creamy melted sauce baked over pasta: sharp and savory with a nutty depth, melts without stringing, golden crust.

name: cacio_e_pepe
description: Finely grated and melted into a glossy pasta sauce: very salty, sharp, tangy and intensely savory, no stretch.

name: fondue_moitie_moitie
description: An Alpine melted-cheese dip: smooth, creamy, gently stretchy, nutty and fruity, slightly funky.

name: quattro_formaggi
description: A baked topping of several cheeses: a stretchy milky base, pockets of sharp blue funk, a buttery nutty melt and a salty savory finish.
